name: BambooHR Thomas2Go Café: Morning Egg, Potato, Bacon & Cheddar Flour Burrito or Scramble Bowl
brandOrRestaurant: Thomas2Go / Thomas Cuisine Café at BambooHR (Lindon / Draper, UT)
whyItWorks: Scratch-cooked eggs, tender diced potatoes, crisp bacon/ham, and aged cheddar wrapped in a warm flour tortilla (or served in a bowl) with zero artificial additives.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the morning Egg, Potato, Bacon/Ham & Cheddar Burrito or Scramble Bowl with no pico de gallo, no bell peppers, and salsa on the side.
watchOuts: Skip the spicy salsa verde, chorizo, and raw pico de gallo
